component.name: ShareX
component.summary: Capture the screen, annotate it and share it

description.p: ShareX captures a region, a window or a whole monitor, lets you annotate the result in a built-in editor, and sends it wherever you want: a file, the clipboard, or one of a long list of upload destinations.

This is the Linux port. Capture goes through xdg-desktop-portal, so it works on Wayland without any privileged access to the display: the compositor renders the image and the user decides, once, what ShareX may see.

ul.li: Screen recording to MP4, WebM or GIF, with an optional webcam overlay
An annotation editor with shapes, text, blur, highlight, steps and stickers
Text recognition, QR codes, image effects and batch conversion tools
Uploads to dozens of image hosts, file hosts and URL shorteners
